name: Media Merge
description: Manually combine a downloaded or local video and audio file into MP4 or MKV without re-encoding. Requires a Motrix build with the manual media merge interface.
ffmpegMissing: Configure FFmpeg in Settings > Integration > Media Tools, then restart the plugin.
outputFormat: Choose an MP4 or MKV output file.
missingStreams: The selected files must provide a video track and an audio track. Check the files and try again.
